# crosswork_data_gateway_global_parameters (Resource)

This resource can manage the global parameters of the Crosswork Data Gateways.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_data_gateway_global_parameters" "example" {
  cli_sessions          = 3
  ssh_session_timeout   = 120
  snmp_trap_port        = 1062
  syslog_udp_port       = 9514
  syslog_tcp_port       = 9898
  syslog_tls_port       = 6514
  resync_snmpv3_details = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cli_sessions` (Number) Number of CLI sessions
  - Range: `1`-`50`
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `resync_snmpv3_details` (Boolean) Whether the SNMPv3 details of a device are synchronised again
- `snmp_trap_port` (Number) SNMP trap port
  - Range: `1`-`65535`
- `ssh_session_timeout` (Number) SSH session timeout in seconds
  - Range: `5`-`900`
- `syslog_tcp_port` (Number) Syslog TCP port
  - Range: `1`-`65535`
- `syslog_tls_port` (Number) Syslog TLS port
  - Range: `1`-`65535`
- `syslog_udp_port` (Number) Syslog UDP port
  - Range: `1`-`65535`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_data_gateway_global_parameters.example "data_gateway_global_parameters"
```
